proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit speed reduction (-10 ft until start of next turn) requires a new variant in the Effect union. The v4 atom modify_speed exists, but Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect — no surface type for modify_speed in an Effect position.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

proposed_widenings.name: onHit multi-effect support
proposed_widenings.justification: Ray of Frost delivers both damage AND speed reduction on the same hit. The current onHit: Effect field accepts a single effect. Encoding both requires either onHit: ReadonlyArray<Effect> or a CompositeEffect variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

notes: The activation family and attack_roll phase fit cleanly. Damage (1d8 cold, threshold_tiers axis=character) typechecks and traces without error. The speed reduction rider is the only gap: modify_speed is in v4 but not in the Effect union, and onHit currently accepts one Effect. Trace covers the damage portion honestly; speed reduction is explicitly omitted. Same pattern as Chill Touch (omitted block_healing rider), but the needed atom here (modify_speed) already exists in v4 — only the surface type is missing.
